items.title: What a Republican 'wipeout' in the midterm elections means for investors
items.summary: Veda Partners managing partner and director of economic policy Henrietta Treyz outlines the type of policy shifts that could affect investors most if the Republicans end up "wiping out" in the midterm elections.

items.title: Why hardware will attract buyers to Apple's new lineup over AI features
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to report on Apple's (AAPL) latest lineup of products, including Siri AI and the iPhone Duo, and why buyers may be driven to buy new products for the hardware features rather than the AI integration.

items.title: Can Apple Stock's Premium Survive The Memory Squeeze On Its Margin?
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) is selling iPhones and Macs faster than it can build them, but the number a holder should fear most is the gross margin underneath those sales. Leaving out tariff refunds, that margin fell in the June quarter and is guided lower again for the September quarter. Management puts both steps down to rising memory prices, while the stock's price-to-earnings multiple sits near the top of its 10-year range.

items.title: Should Qualcomm Stockholders Worry About Its Shrinking Revenue?
items.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) grew revenue just 1.9% over the last twelve months, against a compound pace of about 6.2% a year over five years and 4.5% over three. The quarterly path is worse. Across the last four quarters, year-over-year growth slid from 10.0% to 5.0%, then to declines of 3.5% and 4.0%. That turn to shrinking quarterly sales is the risk to weigh.

items.title: Apple Stock Has Returned Nearly 1,200% in 10 Years. How High Can AAPL Go From Here?
items.summary: Apple just posted its strongest June quarter ever, yet Wall Street has set a price target below where the stock trades today. Something does not add up, and the path to $450 per share is either a stretch case or the most obvious trade nobody wants to own.

items.title: ‘Apple and Microsoft Look Like Value Stocks’: Morningstar on SanDisk’s 2,107% Year
items.summary: A single flash-memory stock has quietly redrawn the boundary between growth and value investing, leaving retirement savers in supposedly defensive index funds holding far more AI-cycle risk than they realize.

items.title: Apple’s $164 Billion Rally Hinges on iPhone Duo Adoption Among 6 Million Premium Buyers
items.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone triggered a market cap surge measured in hundreds of billions, but whether that single-session verdict survives contact with real consumer demand is a question Wall Street has not finished answering.

items.title: Bank of America resets Apple stock price target after iPhone Duo launch
items.summary: Bank of America just published its verdict, and it cuts both ways.
